reevaluation: The finding stands with no change to verdict, confidence or scope: fields.mdx is untouched since the tested tag, so every published create and update example on that page still 400s as printed, and both contracts it confuses are still live. The only material update is that the fix PR #3136 is now based on main rather than on a sibling docs branch, which removes the review's 'cannot land until the whole stack is reviewed' obstacle; three PRs from that same stack merged into v2.17.0 this morning, so this one is plausibly next. The review's upstream claims all still hold, with that one correction about the base branch.
notes: D11 and D12 are the same PR and should be handled in one comment. The comment's added value over the PR text is the reproduction: the exact 400 body {"issues":[{"path":["envelopeId"],"message":"Required"},{"path":["data"],"message":"Required"}]} from posting the page's own curl, plus the observation the PR does not state, that the documented body is not invented but is the live contract of the still mounted legacy POST /api/v2/document/field/create-many, so a reader who found the page plausible was not being careless. If the maintainers prefer, the alternative one-line fix is to repoint the samples at the legacy URLs.
